title: WPSS/888/2004 of SMT. SUMITRA PANWAR and ANR Vs DIRECTOR BASIC and SECONDARY EDUCATION and ORS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT
NAINITAL
WRIT PETITION NO. 888 (SS) OF 2004
1. Smt. Sumitra Panwar, W/o Sri Bachan Singh, presently
serving as Assistant Teacher, Primary School Khaand
(Nagar Kshetra), Vikas Khand Bhatwari, District
Uttarkashi.
2. Smt.Vijay Laxmi Joshi, W/o Sri Kanti Prasad Joshi
presently serving as Assistant Teacher, Primary School,
Khaand (Nagar Kshetra) Vikas Khand Bhatwari, District
Uttarkashi. ...............Petitioners.
 Versus
1. Direcor, Basic & Secondary Education, Uttaranchal,
Dehradun.
2. District Basic Education Officer, Uttarkashi.
3. Smt. Shambhavi Chauhan, W/o Sri Khajaan Singh
Chauhan, serving as Assistant Teacher, Kanya Junior
High School, Gyanshu (Maina Garh), Vikas Khand
Bhatwari, District Uttarkashi. ............Respondents.
Sri Manoj Tiwari, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Learned Standing Counsel for the respondents.
 Dated: 03.03.2006
Hon'ble Rajesh Tandon, J.
 By the present writ petition, the petitioners have prayed
for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondent no. 2 to
forthwith consider and promote them to the post of Assistant
Teacher, Kanya Junior High School, Gyanshu (Maina Garh),
Nagar Kshetra, Uttarkashi. Further prayer has been made for a
writ of a mandamus directing the respondent no. 2 to recall the
transfer order dated 18.12.2003 passed in respect of
Respondent No. 3 and pass a fresh order regarding posting of
Respondent No. 3 within the same local area where she was
appointed and was serving. Further prayer has been made for
a writ of mandamus commanding the respondent no. 2 to
make transfer of Assistant Teachers Junior Basic Schools and
Senior Basic Schools within the same local area in accordance

with the relevant Service Rules, so that chances of promotion
of Teachers serving in the local areas are not adversely
affected.
2. Briefly stated, the petitioner no. 1 was appointed on
regular basis as Assistant Teacher, Primary School w.e.f.
16.01.1980 in Primary School, Birla Gali, Uttarkashi,
Petitioner No. 2 was appointed on regular basis as Assistant
Teacher, Primary School, Gandhi Vidya Mandir w.e.f.
10.09.1985, which are situated within Nagar Kshetra,
Uttarkashi and the said institutions were being run by the U.P.
Basic Education Board at the relevant point of time.
3. According to the petitioners they are continuously
working as Assistant Teacher, Primary School in Nagar
Kshetra, Uttarkashi although petitioners were transferred
from one Institution to another from time to time in
accordance with Rule 21 of U.P. Basic Education (Teachers)
Services Rules 1981. Their services were confirmed on
01.06.1986 and 10.09.1987 respectively.
4. In the last seniority list circulated in the month of June,
2004, petitioner no. 1 (Smit Sumitra Panwar) stands at Serial
No. 1 and petitioner no. 2 (Smt. Vijay Laxmi Joshi) at Serial
No. 2 amongst teachers of Primary Schools serving within
Nagar Kshetra, Uttarkashi. As such the petitioners rank at the
top amongst teachers serving in Primary Schools in the said
local area and they have a vested right to be considered for
promotion against the available vacancies.
5. Counsel for the petitioners has submitted that a Girls
Junior High School was opened by the Department at Gyanshu
(Maina Garh) District Uttarkashi in December, 2003 under
the Education programme. The said school was sanctioned
for Kotegoan (Mautar), Vikas Khand, Mauri. However,
pursuant to decision taken in the meeting dated 06.02.2003

presided over by District Magistrate, Uttarkashi, the School
was opened in Gyanshu (Maina Garh) which falls within Nagar
Kshetra, Uttarkashi.
6. Petitioners have submitted that since the new Junior
High School falls within Nagar Kshetra Uttarkashi as such the
Assistant Teachers serving in Primary Schools within said local
area alone are entitled for promotion against the two posts of
Assistant Teachers, Junior High School created for the said
institution. Pursuant to the representation made by the
persons serving as Assistant Teacher, Primary School within
Nagar Kshetra, Uttarkashi, the respondent no. 2 sought
guidance from State Project Director, Uttaranchal (Education
For All), Education Board, Dehradun vide letter dated
06.01.2004.
7. Pursuant to the letter dated 06.01.2004 issued by the
respondent no.2, Director of Education, Uttaranchal replied
vide letter-dated 17.01.2004 stating that teachers serving on
the post of Assistant Teacher in Nagar Kshetra, Uttarkashi
alone shall be entitled for promotion.
8. The Chairman, Nagar Palika Parisahd Uttarkashi has
also issued one letter-dated 27.12.2003 to the District
Magistrate, Uttarkashi where by it was informed that teachers
serving in Primary Schools within Nagar Kshetra are suffering
stagnation for want of promotional avenues and a request was
made to consider the claim of the teachers serving in the said
local area for promotion against newly created posts.
9. On 02.01.2004, the petitioners alongwith teachers
serving in Basic Schools within Nagar Kshetra Uttarkashi
submitted one representation jointly to the respondent no.2
requesting him to consider the claim of teachers serving within
Nagar Kshetra for promotion against newly created posts in
accordance with seniority.

10. petitioner has submitted that respondent no. 2 has
passed the order on 18.12.2003 whereby respondent no. 3 has
been transferred as Assistant Teacher in Kanya Junior High
School, Gyanshu (Maina Garh) which is in Nagar Kshetra from
Kanya Junior High Schol, Gyonla, Vikas Khand, Dunda,
District Uttarkashi. It has been submitted that respondent no.
3 was appointed in a different local area as she was appointed
for rural area of District Uttarkashi, as such, she cannot be
transferred to an Institution situated in Nagar Kshetra
Uttarkashi in view of the Rule contained in Rule 21 of the
relevant Service Rules.
11. However, liberty is given to the petitioners to file a fresh
representation stating his grievances for promotion within a
period of two weeks from the date of presentation of the
certified copy of the order. If such a representation is filed, the
same shall be disposed of by the concerned authority within a
period of two months thereafter along with the representation
dated 02.01.2004 in accordance with there relevant rules.
12. Writ petition is disposed of. No order as to costs.
(Rajesh Tandon, J.)
03.03.02006
Rathour
